/** * Abstract factory base class that can provide deserializers for standard * JDK classes, including collection classes and simple heuristics for * "upcasting" common collection interface types * (such as {@link java.util.Collection}). *

* Since all simple deserializers are eagerly instantiated, and there is * no additional introspection or customizability of these types, * this factory is stateless. */ @SuppressWarnings("serial") public abstract
